item.title: 'Disneyland Handcrafted,' new Disney+ documentary, shows rare footage of the making of Disneyland
item.description: Watch Walt Disney's dream of creating Disneyland unfold in "Disneyland Handcrafted," streaming January 22 on Disney+ and Disney YouTube.

item.title: US drops the number of vaccines it recommends for every child
item.description: Medical experts slammed the move, saying it could lead to reduced uptake of important vaccinations and increase disease.

item.title: Jury selection begins in trial for ex-officer accused in police response to Uvalde school shooting
item.description: One of the first police officers to respond to the Uvalde school shooting, goes on trial Monday on charges that he failed to protect children during the attack.

item.title: Hegseth censures Sen. Kelly after Democrats' video urging troops to resist unlawful orders
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced Monday that he censured Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly of Arizona over the former Navy pilot's participation in a video that called on troops to resist unlawful orders.

item.title: Here's what caused the Bay Area's highest king tides since 1998
item.description: Record tidal flooding that the Bay Area hasn't seen in 27 years was created by the perfect timing of a full moon as the sun, moon and Earth aligned, and an area of low pressure crossed Northern California.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Storm, flooding concerns wind down overnight; light showers tomorrow morning
item.description: The Coastal Flood Advisory expired at 3 p.m. today, so flooding concerns will be diminishing as our current storm weakens and the rain tapers off. Nonetheless, we should be prepared for rain to continue through this evening before winding down overnight.

item.title: Scientists detect alarming bird population decline in Bay Area: Here's what can be done
item.description: To understand the state and health of birds across the Bay Area, scientists have been watching them closely. The latest report by the San Francisco Bay Joint Venture and Point Blue Conservation Science points to a concerning decline of shorebirds over the last two decades.

item.title: Super Bowl 60 preparations begin in Santa Clara, San Jose 1 month before football's biggest event
item.description: As the NFL season shifts to the playoffs, the planning stage of work for Super Bowl 60 shifts to actual preparations here in the Bay Area. "We'll be on the global stage like we've never been before and we're ready," San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan said.

item.title: 'An insult to the Constitution': Bay Area lawmakers question Pres. Trump's authority in Venezuela
item.description: Bay Area lawmakers are raising constitutional questions over the Trump administration's surprise operation in Venezuela over the weekend. Democrats are arguing the move might violate the War Powers Act by bypassing Congress, while Republicans are largely saying the president acted within his authority.

item.title: Nicolás Maduro declares 'I am innocent' and 'still president' in Manhattan court appearance
item.description: Nicolás Maduro and his wife pleaded not guilty to federal charges Monday in Manhattan federal court.
